summary.headline: Vascon Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue fell to INR152 crores (from INR221 crores) and PAT to INR2 crores (from INR22 crores) on EPC execution delays.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue from operations declined to about INR152 crores from INR221 crores a year earlier, driven by lower EPC execution from cash-flow-constrained government projects. Consolidated EBITDA was INR10 crores versus INR34 crores, which included an INR18 crores one-time investment gain in Q1 FY26; adjusted EBITDA was about INR15 crores, giving a roughly 6% margin. PAT fell to INR2 crores from INR22 crores. Management said execution is expected to recover from August 2026 and targets FY27 revenue of about INR1,200 crores, which now relies heavily on H2 and on real estate revenue in Q4.

segments.name: EPC
segments.commentary: Revenue about INR148 crores (vs INR203 crores) with EBITDA about INR13 crores at roughly 9% margin; external order book INR2,531 crores plus internal INR319 crores, total about INR2,850 crores (about 3x FY26 EPC revenue).

segments.name: Real Estate
segments.commentary: Revenue about INR4 crores with EBITDA loss about INR4 crores; Q1 bookings INR66 crores, Orchid cumulative bookings about INR87 crores after INR38 crores in Q1. Launched Tranquil Heights (Powai) in June; Prakash (Santacruz West) approved, launch pending.

guidance_outlook: FY27 consolidated revenue target still about INR1,200 crores, including INR200 crores-plus from real estate recognised mainly in Q4; EPC target INR1,000 crores (at least INR900 crores).
Q1+Q2 expected to be about 30% of FY27 EPC top line, with Q3+Q4 about 70% (versus typical 40/60).
FY27 EPC order intake target INR1,500-2,000 crores.
Real estate ambition: annual booking value INR1,200-1,500 crores by FY31; management says doubling from current base is minimum target over next 3-4 years.
Real estate revenue recognition targeted in Q3/Q4 via OC for Coimbatore and Tower of Ascend (Kharadi); Orchid Santacruz OC targeted in Q4 if achieved.
Working capital cycle expected to normalise from 65-70 days back toward 45 days; EPC short-term debt to roll over in 6-8 months as projects ramp.
summary.management_tone: Candid and defensive on the quarter, calling it one of the worst in three to four years but attributing it to timing and execution rather than structural issues. Confident on H2 recovery and FY27 targets, while being noticeably vague on Adani and Royal Rides timing.
key_quotes: It has been one of the worst quarters we've had over the last 3 to 4 years, but I think there's nothing structurally wrong that has led to that.
We consider this primarily a timing -related execution issue rather than a structural concern with our order book.
So we are still confident that we can achieve INR1,200 crores.

qa_highlights.question: How much construction spend is pending on real estate projects, and what free cash flow can come from sold and unsold inventory over 2-3 years?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said real estate gross profit remains 25-30%; against about INR400 crores of unsold inventory plus INR116 crores pending collections, about INR300 crores of construction cost is pending, leaving about INR220 crores of free cash flow.

qa_highlights.question: Where has debt gone over the last year given flat EPC order book and real estate outlay?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO attributed the rise mainly to EPC: CC limit utilisation rose since March 2026 due to milestone-based projects, and net working capital cycle moved from about 45 days to 65-70 days over the last 6 months; real estate also needed capital infusion.

qa_highlights.question: Which government projects face cash-flow issues and will there be further delays?
qa_highlights.answer: Management named Bihar Supaul and Sindhudurg (Maharashtra) projects, which were held back for client cash-flow issues; cash flows are now with clients and both are expected to ramp up over the next 1-2 months.

qa_highlights.question: When will real estate revenue be recognised and which projects?
qa_highlights.answer: Coimbatore and Tower of Ascend (Kharadi) OC targeted in Q3/Q4 FY27, and Orchid Santacruz in Q4 only if achieved; no meaningful real estate revenue expected in Q2.

qa_highlights.question: What is the status of Royal Rides (INR225 crores order) and how much revenue is recognised?
qa_highlights.answer: Only ground levelling and initial mobilisation done, about INR15 crores recognised; client has no go-ahead as it is part of a larger BOT ropeway project. Management assumes no revenue from it for the next three quarters but says the order is not cancelled.

qa_highlights.question: Why is the FY27 INR1,200 crore target still achievable given weak Q1?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said EPC should reach at least INR900 crores (targeting INR1,000 crores) and real estate revenue of INR200 crores-plus will come in Q4; H1 expected to be 30% of EPC top line versus typical 40%.

qa_highlights.question: What is the use of the INR80 crore preferential warrants and the Adani outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Warrants come in over 18 months with the first 25% received; about 60-70% for real estate, rest for EPC working capital and corporate purposes. Adani construction start not expected within 6 months, so revenue may slip to Q4 FY27 or FY28.

capex_capacity: Real estate: pipeline of about 1.74 million sq ft salable area with estimated sales value about INR2,000 crores (about INR1,000 crores attributable to Vascon) across Prakash (Santacruz West), Tower of Future (Baner, Pashan, Pune) and Ajanta redevelopment (Kharadi); no new land/project acquisition signed yet, several opportunities being converted over next 2-3 quarters to support launches from FY28.

Real estate project timelines: Orchid Santacruz targeted for OC in Q4 FY27 (tight); Coimbatore and Tower of Ascend (Kharadi) targeted for OC in Q3/Q4 FY27; Powai (Tranquil Heights) is a ~36-month build (2 basements plus 3 basements, ground plus 22 floors, 70m); Prakash redevelopment ~24 months (ground plus 8).

Thane land parcel (Vascon holds 45% of ~150 acres): acquisition still in process; government corridor acquisition has no news in 3-6 months; road-side parcel consolidation slow, no timeline for continuous parcel for at least a year; acquisition value indicated at about INR6-odd crores per acre; Corridor expected to take about 40% of land (~60 acres), of which Vascon ~20-25 acres.

Capital infusion: INR80 crore preferential warrants over 18 months (first tranche of at least 25% received), earmarked about 60-70% for real estate and balance for EPC working capital and general corporate purposes.

EPC order book: INR2,850 crores (external INR2,531 crores plus internal INR319 crores); Royal Rides (Goa, ~INR225 crores) stalled with about INR15 crores revenue recognised, no client go-ahead; Vashi Hospital expected to start in the coming quarter; Vedanta Mumbai high-rise scaled up again with completion targeted in FY27.
demand_pricing: EPC order intake: INR295 crore CPWD order for RBI Colony, Guwahati won in Q1 FY27; LOI of INR126 crores (ex-GST) from Maharashtra PWD for a 300-bed General Hospital at Wardha, received August 12, 2026; FY27 order intake target INR1,500-2,000 crores.

EPC execution moderation in Q1 FY27 attributed to temporary cash-flow constraints at two government projects (Bihar Supaul and Sindhudurg, Maharashtra); management says cash flows now available and ramp-up expected over next 1-2 months. Older projects nearing completion also contributed lower revenue.

Real estate demand: Q1 FY27 booking value INR66 crores (vs INR113 crores for full FY26); new sales about 30,690 sq ft; collections about INR20 crores; Orchid cumulative bookings about INR87 crores after INR38 crores in Q1; Tranquil Heights (Powai) launched second week of June with encouraging early response.

Real estate pricing discipline: management prioritising achieving underwriting price points over volume; targets projects with minimum GDV of INR250-300 crores, with 10-15% upfront investment; competition from local and large developers described as intense.
Real estate margin: gross profit on real estate projects still in 25-30% range per management; EPC gross margin 13-15% on average, with EPC EBITDA margin about 9% in Q1 FY27 vs 8% a year earlier.

Adani Infra engagement: on at least 3-4 projects at early design stage; management does not expect construction start within next 6 months; revenue may slip to Q4 FY27 or next year. Reliance order cancelled by mutual agreement after design and construction method changes (non-Mivan to Mivan).
risks_watch: Execution recovery depends on cash flows from two government clients (Bihar Supaul, Sindhudurg) and on the August 2026 ramp-up timeline; any further client payment delay would hit the H2-weighted FY27 EPC target (INR1,000 crores target, at least INR900 crores).

Working capital cycle at 65-70 days versus about 45 days historically, with EPC short-term debt (rolled over in 6-8 months) and net debt about INR152 crores; CC limit utilisation has risen since March 2026 and INR355 crores of INR760 crores sanctioned limits remain unutilised.

Real estate revenue of INR200 crores-plus in FY27 is concentrated in Q3/Q4 and depends on OC timing for Coimbatore, Tower of Ascend and Orchid Santacruz; slippage would put the INR1,200 crore target at risk.

Order book quality: Royal Rides (about INR225 crores) stalled with no client go-ahead; Vashi Hospital not yet kicked off; Adani engagement unlikely to start construction within six months; Reliance order cancelled.

Real estate land bank and acquisitions: no new project signed yet despite the 1,200-1,500 crore FY31 booking ambition; Thane land parcel acquisition incomplete with no timeline for a continuous parcel beyond a year; intense competition for redevelopment projects in Mumbai.

adds.what: Real estate project completions (OC) for Coimbatore, Tower of Ascend (Kharadi) and Orchid Santacruz; not physical production capacity

growth.why: Management holds FY27 consolidated revenue at about INR1,200 crore and EPC at INR1,000 crore, but Q1 revenue fell 31% to INR152 crore and the back-loaded 70/30 H2 split depends on cash-flow-constrained government projects ramping, backed by a INR2,850 crore EPC order book and real estate OC timelines that are tight.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: EPC EBITDA margin rose to about 9% from 8% a year ago and EPC gross margin is 13-15%, but real estate posted a about INR4 crores EBITDA loss on INR4 crores revenue, so group margin of about 6% is only flat year on year.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Real estate OC completions for Coimbatore, Tower of Ascend (Kharadi) and Orchid Santacruz are targeted in Q3/Q4 FY27, but these are project completions rather than physical production capacity, and Orchid is only tight if achieved.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Management targets FY27 EPC revenue of INR1,000 crores (at least INR900 crores) against INR148 crores in Q1, so H2 must carry about 70% of EPC top line, backed by a INR2,850 crores EPC order book (about 3x FY26 EPC revenue).

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Utilisation is not disclosed, but management says no new land or project is signed yet, several opportunities are being converted over the next 2-3 quarters, and the INR80 crores warrant tranche is earmarked 60-70% for real estate.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Q1 revenue fell 31% to INR152 crores from INR221 crores and FY27 INR1,200 crores guidance is held only by assuming a steep H2 ramp, so an upgrade is not plausible.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Q1 EPC revenue of INR148 crores against a INR1,000 crores target needs about INR850 crores in Q2-Q4, Royal Rides (INR225 crores) has no client go-ahead, Adani construction is not expected within 6 months, and the Reliance order was cancelled.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Prakash (Santacruz West) is approved with launch pending, and Tranquil Heights (Powai) was launched in June with bookings of INR66 crores in Q1 FY27 against INR113 crores for all of FY26.

rows.label: Working capital cycle normalisation to about 45 days
rows.why: Cycle moved from about 45 days to 65-70 days over the last 6 months and net debt is about INR152 crores, with management expecting a return toward 45 days as projects ramp and EPC short-term debt rolls over in 6-8 months.

rows.label: Royal Rides (Goa) and Adani order conversion
rows.why: Royal Rides (about INR225 crores) has only about INR15 crores recognised with no client go-ahead and is assumed to give no revenue for three quarters, and Adani construction is not expected to start within 6 months, so revenue may slip to Q4 FY27 or FY28.

rows.label: Real estate underwriting-price discipline
rows.why: Management is prioritising underwriting price points over volume, with real estate gross profit still at 25-30%, but competition from local and large developers is described as intense.

tone.note: Management was confident on the H2 EPC ramp, real estate OC timing and the INR1,200 crores target, but cautious and vague on Adani and Royal Rides timing; analysts pushed on the debt rise, the working capital cycle and the back-loaded FY27 guidance.
